text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I am astonished. To think you possessed
such a talent.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Would you be willing to teach me as well
next time?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I too wish
to reach a level of skill comparable to
yours.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, if that's the case,
we might be a little troubled for storage
space.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A splendid idea.
Your office desk is rather drab,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Very well,
I shall arrange the decorations.
...How might I display them to bring ease
to my Trainer's heart?
